question: Which country is hosting the ICC 2023 ODI Cricket World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is **India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India** is hosting the ICC 2023 ODI Cricket World Cup.
 
• This event marks a significant moment for **Indian cricket**, showcasing its capability to host large-scale international tournaments.
 
• The tournament is expected to take place across various iconic cricket stadiums in **India**, highlighting the country's rich cricketing culture and infrastructure.
 
• Hosting the World Cup is a matter of national pride and is anticipated to bring a substantial economic and sporting boost to **India**.
 
• This will be the first time since 2011 that **India** will solely host the ICC ODI World Cup, reflecting its growing stature in the international cricket community.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Event
 Significance
 
 
 
 

 First ODI World Cup
 Held in **1975**, it marked the beginning of what would become one of the most prestigious tournaments in cricket.
 
 

 India's First World Cup Win
 In **1983**, India won its first World Cup, a pivotal moment that boosted the popularity of cricket in the country.
 
 

 2011 World Cup
 Hosted by India, Sri Lanka, and Bangladesh, it saw India winning the tournament for the second time, under the captaincy of **M.S. Dhoni**.
 
 

 Role of ICC
 The **International Cricket Council (ICC)** is the global governing body for cricket, responsible for organizing world-class events like the ODI World Cup.
 
 

 Impact on Host Country
 Hosting the World Cup significantly impacts the host country's economy, infrastructure, and global sporting reputation.
